Setup commands for teleport.corp.example (Teleport 18.7.0), generated by the
tangra deployment wizard. Run them on the Teleport host once install.sh has
finished and https://teleport.corp.example/ answers.

1. Create the first administrator. Open the invite link tctl prints and set
   a password and second factor:

   sudo tctl users add alice@corp.example --roles=editor,access,auditor --logins=ec2-user

2. Create the least-privilege role and the management identity tangra signs
   in with (tangra-manager-role.yaml was downloaded with this file):

   sudo tctl create -f tangra-manager-role.yaml
   sudo tctl users add tangra-mgmt --roles=tangra-manager
   sudo tctl auth sign --user=tangra-mgmt --format=file --ttl=720h --out=tangra-mgmt.identity

3. Register the cluster in tangra: choose "Register this cluster" in the
   wizard. The proxy address is teleport.corp.example:443; upload tangra-mgmt.identity
   as the credential, then delete the file from the host.

4. Optional, for portal terminals and tsh downloads: create the access role
   and user (tangra-access-role.yaml was downloaded with this file), open
   the invite link tctl prints and set a password and second factor:

   sudo tctl create -f tangra-access-role.yaml
   sudo tctl users add tangra-access --roles=tangra-access

   Then sign in once as tangra-access from any machine with tsh (it asks
   for the password and the second factor; --ttl is in minutes, at most
   the role's max_session_ttl of one year):

   tsh login --proxy=teleport.corp.example:443 --user=tangra-access --ttl=525600 --format=file --out=tangra-access.identity

   Upload tangra-access.identity on the cluster page ("Access identity for
   portal terminals"), then delete the file. Repeat before it expires.
